title: Maestro flow intent
description: Structured representation of the user journey the audit should simulate. The LLM fills this contract (constrained by schema), and `scripts/render_flow_yaml.py` deterministically renders the corresponding Maestro YAML. The LLM never emits YAML directly — this avoids invented element labels and broken indentation.

app_id.description: appId Maestro should target. For Android, the applicationId; for iOS, the bundle identifier. Same flow file can be reused across platforms via maestro's `--app-id` override.

email_field_label.description: Visible label / placeholder Maestro will tap to focus the email field.

steps.description: Ordered list of high-level actions. Each action is one of a small fixed set; the renderer expands each into 1..N Maestro steps. Every step is rendered with `optional: true` unless its `required` field is set; this prevents a single mis-guessed label from aborting the whole flow.

label.description: Visible text / accessibility label for tap_label.

index.description: Index for tap_index inside a list view.

screen_label.description: Friendly name attached to this step (surfaces in flashlight intervals).

scroll_count.description: Number of times to scroll for `scroll` actions.

post_login_assertions.description: Optional set of labels Maestro should assert visible after login completes. Used as a hint to fail fast if login silently fails.

model_name.description: LLM that produced the refinement, if any.
